name: inspira-liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass
blurb: Liquid glass morphism effect with SVG displacement mapping.
description: Container creating frosted glass effect with SVG-based displacement distortion. Highly configurable blend modes, channels, and visual parameters.
use_when: Premium UI elements, overlays, or cards with glass morphism aesthetics.
avoid_when: Older browsers or when SVG displacement maps aren't supported.
a11y: Glass effect is purely visual; semantic content provided via children.
